beats.say: When a signature request arrives, first ask yourself: did I start this request?
The request shows the document name and the service asking. Reject a request you did not expect.
Do not sign without reading. The name, amount and recipient must match what you expect.
When in doubt, do not sign, and tell the security team. A signature is hard to take back.

scenes.title: Signature requests
scenes.intro: During the day, signature requests arrive on your phone. Check each one and decide.

steps.label: You were not about to sign anything

actions.label: Open and sign
actions.feedback: You signed a power of attorney someone else prepared. Call the signature service and the security team at once.

actions.label: Reject
actions.feedback: Right. A request you did not start means someone is trying to use your name.

actions.label: Tell the security team
actions.feedback: Well done. Rejecting and reporting stops the attack in time.

body.text: I sent you a contract in SənədAxını. No time to read it, just sign quickly, the boss is waiting.

actions.label: I read the document first
actions.feedback: Right. Being rushed is no reason to skip reading, the signature is your responsibility.

actions.label: Fine, I sign without reading
actions.feedback: An unread document may have a changed amount or recipient.

actions.label: Sign in
actions.feedback: A fake sign-in page took your password. Change it now and tell the security team.

actions.label: Report phishing
actions.feedback: Right. The domain is not SənədAxını's, open the system yourself.

actions.label: Delete
actions.feedback: Safe. But if you report it, others are protected too.

steps.label: You just started signing your leave request on the portal

actions.label: Open and sign
actions.feedback: Right. You started this request and the document and service are what you expect.

actions.label: Reject
actions.feedback: Not needed: the request was yours and everything matches. Checking does not mean rejecting everything.

steps.label: You ordered an employment certificate on the portal
steps.say: Compare the document name with what you expect.

actions.label: Open and sign
actions.feedback: This was a bank power of attorney, not your certificate. If the name does not match, do not sign.

actions.label: Reject
actions.feedback: Right. Neither the document nor the service is what you expect, so reject and report it.

scenes.prompt: Before signing, find what is wrong with this request.

body.text: Power of attorney: full authority over all bank accounts

spots.label: Full authority
spots.explain: This document gives someone wide rights over your accounts. Such a document should never arrive unexpectedly.

spots.label: Someone you do not know
spots.explain: If you do not know who receives the authority, do not sign.

spots.label: Long term
spots.explain: A three year power of attorney lets the damage go on for a long time.

spots.label: Unknown service
spots.explain: The request comes from an unknown website, not an official system you know.

scenes.prompt: Put the steps before signing in order.

items.label: Check that you started the request
Check the name, amount and recipient

scenes.explain: If any step does not match, stop and reject. Report a suspicious request to the security team.

question.prompt: You signed a suspicious document by mistake. What is the first step?

options.label: I tell no one, maybe nothing happens
options.feedback: The signature is valid and can be used. Hiding it makes the damage worse.

options.label: I call the signature service and the security team at once
options.feedback: Right. The service can suspend the certificate, and the security team looks into the consequences.

options.label: I only change my PIN
options.feedback: Useful, but the signed document is still valid. Report it first.

scenes.explain: With a wrong signature, time matters. Reporting fast gives a chance to stop the document being used.

points: Confirm a signature request only if you started it yourself.
Read the document: name, amount and recipient must match what you expect.
If you signed by mistake, tell the signature service and the security team at once.
